analysis.overall: The day had a solid amount of time in range, though things got a bit bumpy with a low in the evening, a stubborn high overnight, and a pump connectivity hiccup that caused some morning turbulence.

events.title: Evening low
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 63 mg/dL before rebounding sharply after some recovery action and incoming insulin.

events.title: Pump connection issues
events.description: Repeated 'Pump unreachable' warnings caused some device frustration right around morning routines.

events.title: Sharp morning drop and bounce
events.description: A quick dip down to 90 mg/dL was followed by a fast upward trend right before breakfast carbs were entered.

events.title: Post-breakfast climb
events.description: A 60g carb breakfast led to a steady climb peaking near 224 mg/dL despite multiple correction boluses.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on pump connectivity and pre-bolus timing for larger carb meals to avoid those sharp late-morning climbs.
